author: Good Work
description:
Join Good Work’s Patreon for live show tapings, extended interviews, meetings with the team, and more: https://patreon.com/goodwork

The tech industry’s days of nap pods and ping pong are over. Welcome to the hardo era. Featuring interviews with:

Margaret O’Mara, Silicon Valley historian and Professor at the University of Washington (https://www.margaretomara.com/)

Rya Jetha, former tech reporter at the San Francisco Standard (https://x.com/reeyopeeyo)

Maceo Kwik, founder of Datost (https://www.linkedin.com/in/maceo-cardinale-kwik/)

Jayden Clark, tech commentator (https://x.com/creatine_cycle)

Created by Dan Toomey, Jack Stebbins, and Henry Stockwell
Audience development: Jen Walsh
Thumbnail design: Seth Laupus
Bumper GFX: Tiffany Lacata and Amelia Kissinger
title: Why fun tech jobs went extinct
